framework_reference_decision: No web framework detected. Per WORKFLOW.md 4.2.3, source/sink shapes were derived from repository code using the Python language reference only; assumptions recorded in this file.
assumptions: Project is a CLI document-processing tool: the attacker-relevant input boundary is the spec source (file path, '-' stdin, or https: URL) plus CLI arguments, not HTTP request parameters.
serve mode's http.server handler serves static output files only; it is not modeled as a request source.
tests/ contains no Python files; a defensive path-based test filter is kept in both queries.
release.py is build/release tooling at repo root but part of the database; it is kept as candidates and left for LLM labeling rather than pre-filtered.
sys.argv is only used for the argparse subparser hack (len/append); the argparse add_argument surface is extracted instead as the CLI source family.
eval/exec usage exists (bikeshed/cli.py:573,578, bikeshed/extensions.py:8, bikeshed/highlight.py:385) but is Pass 4 (code injection) territory; out of scope for this Pass 2 extraction.
